name: DevOps Engineer
title: DevOps Engineer
intro: The DevOps roadmap: Linux and scripting, Git and CI/CD, containers, cloud and monitoring, with job steps.

phases.title: Class 10–12: foundation subjects
phases.summary: Build maths and logic habits; no single stream is mandatory.
points: DevOps is open to students of any stream, but Maths and Computer Science/Informatics Practices in Class 11–12 give a faster start.
Learn basic programming (Python or C) and use free resources such as SWAYAM, NPTEL and official language documentation.
Learn how websites are hosted and deployed to understand why DevOps exists.
Practise typing, English reading and logical problem-solving; they matter in every technical interview.

phases.title: Degree route and admission
phases.summary: Choose a degree that fits your budget and goals; skills matter as much as the degree.
points: Common routes into DevOps: B.Tech/B.E. (CSE, IT, ECE), BCA, BSc Computer Science/IT, and BSc in related subjects; JEE Main, state CETs and CUET-UG are the main admission exams.
Choose a college that offers labs, active coding clubs and a record of internships and campus placements.
Non-degree path: self-learning plus certifications and a strong GitHub portfolio can open entry-level roles, though many employers still prefer a degree.
Confirm AICTE and UGC approval of the college before paying fees.

phases.title: Linux, scripting and version control
points: Learn Linux administration, shell scripting and basic networking.
Learn Git workflows and branching.
Learn a programming language such as Python.
Understand how applications are built, tested and released.

phases.title: CI/CD, containers and orchestration
points: Learn CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins.
Learn Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals.
Learn configuration management (Ansible) and infrastructure as code (Terraform).
Build a pipeline that tests and deploys a sample app.

phases.title: Cloud, monitoring and security
points: Learn one cloud platform and its core services.
Learn monitoring and logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
Learn secrets management and DevSecOps basics.
Prepare for certifications such as AWS, Azure or Kubernetes (CKA).

phases.title: Internship, portfolio and first job
phases.summary: Turn skills into proof and apply through campuses and job portals.
points: Build 3–4 solid projects, host the code on GitHub and write short READMEs that explain the problem and your decisions.
Apply for internships in your second and third year; start-ups and remote internships often take beginners.
Typical first roles: junior DevOps engineer, build and release engineer, cloud operations engineer.
Growth paths include senior DevOps, site reliability engineer and platform engineering.
Prepare for aptitude tests, technical interviews and HR rounds; practise mock interviews and communication.
facts: junior DevOps engineer, build and release engineer, cloud operations engineer
